review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 canonical items (each has two context-only variants). Both items measure vocabulary knowledge and usage; metadata is appropriate and educationally coherent. Verdict: PASS for both.

Part 2/5: 審核 2 題現代文閱讀選擇題的 metadata。兩題均測驗閱讀理解中「由行動或證據推論作者／人物態度與寫作方法」的技能；標籤、主題與模組均與題幹要求一致，無需修訂。

Part 3/5: Reviewed 2 items (each with two context-only variants) for metadata alignment. Both items correctly label the assessed skill as classical-Chinese vocabulary/sentence comprehension within basic classical-Chinese study and comprehension/application module. Recommend no changes.

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants sharing metadata). Both items correctly assess rhetorical/expressive skills and have appropriate topic, label and module assignments. Recommend no changes.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items measure the skills their metadata claim and require no substantive changes.

reviews.reason: The item asks for the closest meaning of the word 「顧及」 and requires students to identify the correct synonym from options. This is a straightforward vocabulary/word-meaning item. The label '語基與詞語' and topic '語基與詞語' accurately describe the skill, and the module '基礎掌握' is an appropriate classification.

The item asks which sentence is most appropriate for using 「顧及」, testing vocabulary use in context (word choice/usage). The existing label '詞語運用', topic '語基與詞語', and module '基礎掌握' accurately reflect the assessed skill.
題幹要求從人物行動歸納其做事方式（推論人物態度／方法），屬於現代文閱讀的理解與應用範疇。現有標籤“現代文理解”、主題“現代文閱讀”、模組“理解與應用”與實際評量技能一致，故通過。
題目測驗學生是否能找出支持關於「作者重視資料」判斷的文本證據，屬於主旨與證據辨認的閱讀技能。標籤“主旨與證據”、主題“現代文閱讀”、模組“理解與應用”均貼切，故通過。

The item asks for the meaning of the classical character 「故」 in context, so it assesses word-level knowledge in classical Chinese. The label '文言實詞' (classical lexical item), topic '文言基礎', and module '理解與應用' accurately describe this skill.
The item asks for the main learning-method message of the sentence, assessing sentence-level comprehension in classical Chinese. The label '文言句意', topic '文言基礎', and module '理解與應用' are appropriate.
The stem asks students to identify the rhetorical device used in a phrase (personification). The topic and label '修辭與表達' and module '理解與應用' accurately describe this skill.

The item asks for the communicative/effect purpose of using concrete examples to support a viewpoint—an assessment of expression effect and rhetorical function. The metadata '修辭與表達' (topic), '表達效果' (label) and '理解與應用' (module) are appropriate.

The question asks students to identify the most logical paragraph arrangement (relationship among viewpoint, examples, reflection). The label '段落組織／篇章結構', topic '段落與篇章組織' and module '理解與應用' accurately describe this skill.
The item tests making a supported response by stating an opinion and linking it to textual evidence. The label '觀點回應與證據支持', topic '觀點與文本證據連結' and module '理解與應用' correctly identify the measured skill.
